venira.avoid_when: nothing should be committed (git only stages when paths are given, or you already staged). Merge/rebase and push are not performed.
venira.output_kind: sha, short_sha, subject, files_changed, files, amend. No staged changes gives invalid_request (pass paths or stage first).
venira.speed_profile: one git add (only when paths given) plus one git commit; output is the new HEAD plus file count.
venira.use_when: your edits are ready to be committed locally.

description:
Commit changes. Without paths: commit whatever is staged (paths given to it are staged first with git add). Amend is opt-in.
Use when: your edits are ready to be committed locally.
Avoid when: nothing should be committed (git only stages when paths are given, or you already staged). Merge/rebase and push are not performed.
Output: sha, short_sha, subject, files_changed, files, amend. No staged changes gives invalid_request (pass paths or stage first).

allow_empty.description: true allows an empty commit (git commit --allow-empty).

amend.description: true amends HEAD instead of creating a new commit.

message.description: Commit message (first line is the subject).

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to stage. Omit to commit what is already staged.

name: git_commit
title: Git commit
